create_TREC_dataset: create a TREC classification dataset instance with Hugging Face identifier and six coarse label categories
load_trec_dataset: load the TREC dataset from Hugging Face using the datasets library and return it
map_hf_dataset_to_list: map a Hugging Face dataset split to a list of text and label tuples
get_train_test_lines: split the TREC training data into 80 percent train and 20 percent test sets
generate_k_shot_data: generate k-shot few-shot learning data splits for the TREC classification task with a given seed
